method: Recorded upstream fixtures are fed to the proxy's own code paths (CustomStreamWrapper, stream_chunk_builder, OllamaChatConfig.transform_request, OllamaChatCompletionResponseIterator.chunk_parser). No HTTP proxy, no provider call, no API key; the fixture is the upstream, so a mismatch is the proxy hop.

F1_split_delta_reemit.note: CustomStreamWrapper re-emission of the recorded upstream stream; ids and names are read from the emitted delta.tool_calls.

F1_split_delta_assembled.note: stream_chunk_builder() assembly of the same recorded stream.

F2_whole_call_one_delta_reemit.note: CustomStreamWrapper re-emission of the recorded upstream stream; ids and names are read from the emitted delta.tool_calls.

F2_whole_call_one_delta_assembled.note: stream_chunk_builder() assembly of the same recorded stream.

F3_single_object_delta_assembled.note: dict-shaped delta.tool_calls assembled by stream_chunk_builder(); an empty list means the call vanished without an exception.

F4_request_transform_assistant_id.note: OllamaChatConfig.transform_request(); the assistant call is rebuilt with the function only while the tool result keeps its tool_call_id.

F4_stream_id_substitution.note: OllamaChatCompletionResponseIterator.chunk_parser() on the native Ollama chunk that already carries id call_8uaqob2r.
